name: Mark
source:
Fumito's childhood friend. Born in Japan to white parents, because of this he is fluent in Japanese.

A womanizer from a young age he is popular with Japanese women due to being a foreigner. He laments the fact that his beloved friend Fumito is still a virgin at his age.

He regularly records and sells videos of the women he is with, sometimes the women he is with are unware that they are being recorded.
